1.w: For the music director, to be accompanied by stringed instruments; a well-written song by David. It was written when the Ziphites came and informed Saul: “David is hiding with us.” O God, deliver me by your name. Vindicate me by your power.

2.w: O God, listen to my prayer. Pay attention to what I say.

3.w: For foreigners attack me; ruthless men, who do not respect God, seek my life. (Selah)

4.w: Look, God is my deliverer. The Lord is among those who support me.

5.w: May those who wait to ambush me be repaid for their evil. As a demonstration of your faithfulness, destroy them.

6.w: With a freewill offering I will sacrifice to you. I will give thanks to your name, O Lord , for it is good.

7.w: Surely he rescues me from all trouble, and I triumph over my enemies.
